answer: In an agent marketplace planning a voyage past a reef, every bidding identity must lock $100 in escrow for 30 days before its bids count. A whisper of extra demand cannot become thousands of credible bidders for free: 10,000 fake identities require $1 million locked up for a month. This stake requirement does not prove identities are unique; it makes influence scale with committed capital, imposing a financing cost on the attacker.
